name: Larchstay
summary: A host app for six holiday cabins: drawn site map, drag-to-move calendar, cleaning and guest chat
about: A complete host app for a small site of six holiday cabins in a mountain valley, with a year of sample bookings in rupees. A drawn site map shows which cabins are lit and smoking from the chimney, the calendar lets you drag stays to new dates or cabins, and housekeeping, guests, revenue and messages each have their own page. Good for a holiday let, glamping site, guest house or small resort, in day and night themes.
how: Open Overview: cabins pop onto the hillside map; lit windows and chimney smoke mean guests are in. Click a cabin for its details
Check guests in or out from Today; checking out sends the cabin to the housekeeping board
In Calendar, drag a stay sideways to change dates or up and down to change cabin; clashes bounce back. Arrow keys do the same
Click an empty day to book it; the form checks the mobile number, guest count and free dates
Search, filter, sort and export Bookings; click a row for the stay timeline, payments, cancel or delete
Drag cleaning cards from Dirty to Ready (or use Move to…) and tick each checklist
Reply to guests with quick templates and watch them type back; switch Day and Night or reset the demo in Settings
